text:
alex: Kicking off the staged cutover to v3.5.0 in safety corridor (US-W slice). Seen a slight uptick in errors—holding until we confirm rollback criteria.

deploy-bot: Canary report at 10% traffic: p95 latency +30ms (baseline 120ms -> 150ms), error rate 1.1% (baseline 0.2%). Autorevert thresholds: error_rate > 1.5% OR p95 > 50ms. No auto-revert triggered yet.

maria: Copy. I can pull tail logs and a span sample. Do we want to abort automated roll after we decide?

ravi: If error rate climbs another 0.4% in next 5m we should manual rollback. Prefer partial rollback to avoid blast radius: shift canary back to v3.4.7 and keep 3.5.0 pinned for investigation.

jamie: Agree with partial rollback. I'll update release notes and the public status blurb if we execute. Also proposing we pin dedicated pools for key customers to v3.4.7 during the window.

oncall-sre: Oncall standing by. If you want me to run the rollback I'll do it — call it out and I'll execute.

maria: Logs look like increased 5xx originating from the kv-cache hotpath. Attaching sample trace ids: trace-abc123, trace-def456. Looks like a regression in async prefetch.

ravi: That matches a metric spike on the prefetch latency graph. So plan: suppress deploy-bot auto-retries, roll canary back to v3.4.7 now, keep 3.5.0 in staging, and open a bug linking traces + PR.

alex: Sounds good. Confirmation checklist: 1) suppress auto-redeploy 2) pin original version for canary 3) notify customers on the list 4) create postmortem ticket. Who wants to run steps?

jamie: I'll handle comms and pin dedicated pools. Drafting notice: "We observed increased errors in a limited cutover to v3.5.0 and are rolling the canary back to maintain SLOs. No customer action required."

deploy-bot: Action: suppress-autoretry ON for rollout-id: r-1749876500 (requested by alex).

oncall-sre: Executing rollback command now: `rwctl rollout set --id r-1749876500 --target v3.4.7 --percent 100 --scope canary`  — monitoring. :eyes:

maria: Metrics flattening in 30s, error rate down to 0.25% now. p95 back to 125ms.

ravi: Good. Keep 3.5.0 pinned in staging and assign an owner for the kv-cache fix (assigning to @maria and @ravi).

ajex: :thumbsup:  (typo in handle to simulate real Slack)

alex: OK. Closing the safety corridor action. jamie please post updated release note and cc legal if there's any outward comms. oncall-sre, please keep an eye for regressions for the next 2 hours and escalate if anything else pops.

jamie: Posted release-notes draft and customer-blast in #customer-notify. Link: https://redwood.internal/notes/1749876543.

oncall-sre: Monitoring window open until 174987... +2h. Will ping if we see any reoccurrence.

alex: Thanks team. Filing the follow-up ticket: RD-1749 (will attach traces + canary logs).
